label: 01 — The collection
title:
Six projects,
one subdomain each.
intro: Hover to bring a project forward. Tap any card to flip it — you'll get a short clip of it running, the numbers behind it, and a way in.
note: Every project here is free to use. None of them are for commercial sale.

items.name: Bloom View
items.description: A calmer way to see what's growing — visual tracking that turns slow progress into something you can actually watch happen.

items.name: IG Scout
items.description: Research Instagram profiles and content without the doomscroll. Search, surface and compare what's actually performing.

items.name: Big Valid
items.description: Bulk validation that tells you the truth fast. Paste a list, get clean results, keep moving — no dashboard tour required.

items.name: Experience Finder
items.description: Stop searching "things to do near me" and getting ads. Tell it the mood, the budget and the day — it does the rest.

items.name: Event Scout
items.description: Everything happening near you, pulled into one feed you can actually filter. Built because five event sites is four too many.

items.name: Date Jar
items.description: Pull a date night out of a jar. For couples who keep saying "we should do something" and never decide what.
